display.purpose: Page-level h1, hero mastheads. The largest type on any page.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, list items, default text. Cap line length at 65 to 75 ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, tab labels, eyebrow-style metadata.

eyebrow.purpose: Small uppercase context line above section headlines, gold colored. Signature CCC primitive.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Card resting state. Subtle hover for interactive list items. Always present on cards by default.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Card hover state. Lift when an interactive surface acknowledges intent.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Auth cards, modals, the substantial substrates. Used at rest, not as hover lift.

shadows.name: shadow-gold
shadows.purpose: Gold CTA hover glow. The literal trophy glint. Reserved for primary-CTA hover.

motion.name: transition-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease for state transitions on color, border, opacity, box-shadow.

motion.name: card-hover-curve
motion.purpose: Card transform on hover. Slight overshoot (1.56 peak) gives the lift a confident flick.

motion.name: card-shadow-curve
motion.purpose: Card box-shadow on hover. Standard ease while transform overshoots.

components.name: Live Indicator (dot + label)
components.description: A small pill that signals a game is live in progress. Live Red dot with subtle pulse, paired with a Teko label. Color is never alone.
components.css: .ds-live-indicator { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: 'Teko', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #E63946; } .ds-live-dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #E63946; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.6); animation: ds-live-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-live-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.6); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(230, 57, 70, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(230, 57, 70, 0); } } .ds-live-label { color: #E63946; }

narrative.overview: The official sports paper of an exclusive members' club. Every leaderboard reads as published. Every result archives itself into club history. The UI combines editorial hierarchy with lounge-level exclusivity. A private sports bulletin assembled inside the club itself. Editorial hierarchy, trophy-room warmth, live-game intensity, and insider rivalry coexist on the same surface. Gold accents feel ceremonial and noble, never corporate. Purple feels like the room itself: deep, social, competitive, royal.
narrative.emotionalAnchor: Tonight's results matter because the club will remember them.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial newspaper hierarchy, not SaaS-dashboard density
Brand-tinted depth (purple shadows, gold glow), never neutral gray
Quiet authority in chrome, loud moments at primary CTAs
Mobile-first surfaces (375 px viewport is the design floor)
Three game palettes layered over CCC chrome via body.game-<slug> overrides
Newsreader serif paragraphs, Teko condensed-sans headlines, no third font

rules.name: The Trophy Rule
rules.body: The metal-gold gradients are reserved for primary CTAs and the active navbar button. Gold gradients on cards, page backgrounds, badges, or decorative chrome dilute the trophy.

rules.name: The Two-Color Rule
rules.body: CCC is purple plus gold on bone. Game tertiaries layer only when the surface is scoped under a body.game-<slug> class.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: Page background is Pressroom Bone (#F3EFE6), not white. Literal #FFFFFF is reserved for nested .card interiors.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: All text and gray-feeling utility colors carry a subtle purple cast. Never neutrally gray.

rules.name: The Newsroom Rule
rules.body: Every heading is Teko. Every paragraph is Newsreader. The two never mix mid-sentence.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section context labels use the Eyebrow primitive: Teko 500, 0.85rem, uppercase, 0.14em letter-spacing, color gold. Don't invent a kicker pattern.

rules.name: The Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for Teko only (labels, eyebrows, button text, table heads, navbar links). Newsreader is never uppercased.

rules.name: The Line-Length Rule
rules.body: Newsreader paragraphs cap at 65 to 75 ch. Wider walls of text break the editorial register.

rules.name: The Press-Room Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadows tint with brand purple (or gold on CTA hover). Neutral-gray shadows are slop.

rules.name: The Lift-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards lift slightly (--shadow-sm) at rest, harder on hover (--shadow-md). Flat-at-rest is wrong for CCC.

rules.name: The Atmospheric-Layer Rule
rules.body: When a surface needs more than card-level shadow, add a radial gradient atmosphere on top of, not in place of, the tinted shadow scale.

dos: Do open every primary page with a Teko-display masthead, not a navbar that flows directly into content.
Do use Teko for every heading, eyebrow, button label, table head, and navbar link.
Do use Newsreader for every paragraph, body text, list item, and editorial caption.
Do reserve the metal-gold gradients for primary CTAs and the active navbar button. Nothing else.
Do use the brand-tinted shadow scale on every elevated surface. Cards lift slightly at rest, harder on hover.
Do scope every non-platform color through a body.game-<slug> class. Game palettes layer on the chrome; they never replace it.
Do use Pressroom Bone (#F3EFE6) as the page background. White is for nested cards only.
Do apply gold dividers between major page sections when separation is needed, not colored side-stripes on cards.
Do put light foreground colors on .card.wc-card content, scoped to the card surface.
Do keep button and form min-height at 44 px or larger.
Do cap Newsreader paragraph line length at 65 to 75 ch.
Do carry the Eyebrow primitive above section headlines that need contextual labeling.
donts: Don't use border-left greater than 1 px as a colored accent on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts. The current .card.border-success / .card.border-danger / .card.border-warning / .card.border-primary rules are existing violations to migrate.
Don't apply background-clip text plus a gradient background. The metal-gold gradient is for surfaces, never for type.
Don't use #000 or #fff as text or background colors. Tint every neutral toward brand purple.
Don't use Inter, system-ui, or any other font. Teko and Newsreader define the system.
Don't use neutral-gray shadows. CCC shadows are purple-tinted by design.
Don't apply --metal-gold outside primary-CTA contexts. It is the trophy.
Don't introduce repeating identical card grids (icon plus heading plus text, eight in a row).
Don't apply the hero-metric template (big number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent) without justification.
Don't add a third top-level color outside CCC purple plus gold without scoping it under a game class.
Don't use match.stage|title in Jinja templates. Use the stage_label SSoT helper.
Don't mock dark mode on light surfaces. Auth backdrops and .card.wc-card are the only dark registers.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing on motion. Card hover overshoot is the only deliberate exception.
Don't use em dashes or double hyphens in UI copy. Replace with commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't add navbar items beyond joined-games plus auth links. Navigation overload is an ESPN/Yahoo anti-reference.
Don't introduce 'Powered by' footers, trust badges, or marketing-style hero sections aimed at strangers.
